summary: Independent review accepts the test-only E1703 change and the source-derived correction to its success-control expectation. The pre-correction candidate was preserved and never executed; the only diff from it changes the comment and expected success values to the original submitted draft. Current source confirms profile-create captures name/bio/wishlist before awaiting the provider, while app.mjs delegates input events to updateDraft. The prospectively captured independent focused rerun passed 1/1 with empty stderr and exit 0.

source.candidate_to_current_diff: one test expectation/comment hunk only; held-failure resubmit checks liveDraft; ordinary held success checks submittedDraft

review.held_known_and_unknown_draft_retention: asserted in controller state and rendered field values before and after the held failure
review.provider_write_and_retry: own profile absent after failure; one create service call; canRetry false; public:retry returns nothing_to_retry without increasing create call count
review.fresh_explicit_resubmit: failure path resubmits without payload and checks resulting profile against latest liveDraft
review.ordinary_success: success control checks originally submittedDraft, consistent with captured local constants before await
review.credential_privacy: random password generated in process; existing helper checks it is absent from controller state, runtime inspection, runtime Part values, and storage; captured test streams contain no credentials
review.delegation_claim: app.mjs input listener invokes updateDraft; test calls updateDraft directly, not a mounted browser

runs.name: independent focused regression
runs.command: node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-name-pattern='held profile creation keeps the live create draft through failure and explicit resubmission' checkpoint/vendor/hh/src/public-controller.test.mjs

runs.name: H1 full controller suite evidence reviewed

limits: Controller/render-tree fixture tests only; direct updateDraft invocation is not browser event-dispatch or mounted-browser evidence.
Synthetic fixture only; no backend, real account, production, human acceptance, build, publication, deployment, or Git claim.

The regression checks own-profile absence and service-call counts rather than asserting byte-identical provider storage or Part count on failure; independent E1702 volatile probe separately observed unchanged storage/provider state and one failed receipt (+2 Parts).
